reason: This plugin’s primary function is to customize the DSH web client sidebar interface by replacing the default sidebar shell and brand logo as a fork-level substitute for the upstream `ui-sidebar`; the evidence shows it mainly affects UI layout/branding by registering sidebar slots, disabling the upstream entry to avoid conflicts, and swapping logo rendering.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek 客户端侧边栏插件，用于将默认侧边栏替换为定制版本，并用自定义品牌图标重绘展开与折叠态 Logo，同时接管相关侧边栏槽位的接入。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek web client sidebar plugin that replaces the default sidebar shell with a custom version and swaps the expanded/collapsed branding logo while wiring sidebar-related slots into the DSH UI.

capabilities: Registers a sidebar shell as the replacement for the built-in DSH `ui-sidebar` shell
Provides sidebar child slots for workspaces, settings, and footer actions
Replaces the default expanded/collapsed sidebar brand logo component with a custom image source

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a fork replacement of the upstream `ui-sidebar` that declares `sidebar`, `sidebar.workspaces`, `sidebar.settings`, and `sidebar.footer.action` slots.
`cordis.patch.yml` usage is documented to disable upstream `ui-sidebar` and insert `dsh-ui-sidebar` so it becomes the active sidebar plugin in the bundle patch flow.
`package.json` defines `dsh.bundle.patch` pointing to `cordis.patch.yml`, confirming plugin-side patch-based replacement in the DSH client loading process.
README states branding comes from a hardcoded remote URL in `Logo.tsx` (`https://wfell.top/nicklin-logo.png`) used for expanded/collapsed logo display.
